Name: CP - hapi's pink rabbit merchant cart
Author: luyepiaofeng
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][quote]原本是制作这成为我自己用的cp mod，但决定分享给大家，因为这本来是来自naver的png diy美化，而naver是一个海外玩家很难注册的平台。当创建它成为cp mod时（这也是我第一次创建星露谷物mod），我最终还将png分成多个png以匹配旅行货车的不同部分，如果我让玩家从naver下载原始文件，这可能会让玩家感到困惑因为必须自己把6个不同部分的png分开。所以我决定请求作者的许可，在这里分享他们的美化，幸好她允许了！
i initially created this into a cp mod for personal use, but decided to share it with everyone because this is originally a png diy replacement from naver, which is a platform that is difficult for foreigners to sign up. when creating this into a cp mod (it's also my first time creating a sdv mod), i also ended up separating the png into multiple pngs to match different parts of the cart, this might confuse you if i made you download the original from naver and have to separate the 6 different parts of pngs yourself. so i decided to ask permission from the creator to share this with their png here and they fortunately allowed![/quote]

[size=3]哈皮创建这时是更[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]蓝草重新着色[/url]配合，所以如果您使用不同的重新着色，有可能会看起来有点奇怪。这是cursors.xnb（\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb）的美化mod，因此请确保这不会与影响商家及其购物车的另一个美化mod冲突（例如：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16275]星尘的地图重新纹理[/url]的cursors.png其中包含商家﻿）。这mod是在1.6和smapi 4.0.0+用，所以还请确保这两都更新到最新版本（但如果您正在玩旧版本的游戏和smapi，您也可以尝试）。
hapi made this to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]blue grass recolour[/url], so this might appear weird if you use a different recolour. this is a replacement mod that replaces cursors.xnb (\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb), so please ensure that this does not conflict with another replacement mod that affects the merchant and their cart (e.g: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16275]stardust's maps retexture[/url]'s cursors.png which contains the merchant). this mod is created for 1.6 and smapi 4.0.0+, so please also ensure that both are updated to the latest for this to work (but you can try if you're playing the older version of the game and smapi).[/size]
